method: category- and faction-aware composition of reviewed explosion, debris, impact, smoke and fire raster families

variants.air: blast, outward debris and trailing smoke
variants.ground: blast, debris, short wreck fire and smoke; fortified cannon and coastal flak retain three-stage weapon/ring breakup silhouettes
variants.sea: blast followed by a retained hull that lists, submerges, displaces water separately at bow and stern, smokes and fades
variants.autonomous: cold debris tint plus broken EMP field collapse
variants.infantry: subdued dust/scatter consequence with no wreck fire
variants.mercenary_bosses: gunship cascading roll, three-section armoured-train breakup, and retained missile-cruiser sinking
variants.machine_bosses: cold three-module controller separation and hot forge collapse with independently detached crawler treads
variants.orbital_bosses: extended vacuum breakup with quadrant separation for the phase array and longitudinal infrastructure separation for command, warden and ark platforms

visual_contract.purpose: make destruction communicate material, scale and category rather than replaying one universal flash
reject: single generic explosion for every target
